category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response offers a straight-faced, strategic defense of scheduling an FCS opponent, deploying 'body clock' unironically and with total conviction. It concedes no points and maintains a strong pro-SEC stance.
quote: You have to protect the body clock of these players. These are 18-to-22-year-old young men whose circadian rhythms, whose weekly preparation cycles, whose entire physiological systems are calibrated to a very specific Saturday-Saturday cadence.
